from.place: General Noetherian coefficient form of the affine-free presentation and descent argument

title: Affine free presentation for constructible Noetherian coefficient modules
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, Λ a Noetherian commutative ring, and F a constructible sheaf of Λ-modules [def-constructible-constructible]. There are finite families of affine etale X-schemes U_i and V_j and an exact sequence ⊕_j Λ[h_(V_j)] → ⊕_i Λ[h_(U_i)] → F → 0, where Λ[h_W] is the sheafification of the free module presheaf on the represented etale presheaf h_W. In particular the map to F is the cokernel of the preceding map.

proof.text:
Affine free etale sheaves are constructible by the finite-etale stratification
of their representing morphisms. Finite generation of each stalk provides finitely many
sections, represented on affine pointed etale neighborhoods, surjecting on that stalk.
The failure locus of each finite family is the constructible support of its cokernel.
Compactness of the constructible topology selects finitely many families with empty
intersection of failure loci. Their union gives an epimorphism. Its kernel is constructible
because the coefficient ring is Noetherian. Apply the same construction to the kernel,
then compose with its inclusion. The original epimorphism is the cokernel of this composite.
Zero sheaves and empty bases allow the empty family throughout.

lean.statement: theorem exists_affine_free_etale_presentation_general (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) [IsConstructibleSheaf F] : let P : X.Etale → Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) := fun W => (presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj (uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj W ⋙ ModuleCat.free Λ) ∃ (n m : ℕ) (U : Fin n → X.Etale) (V : Fin m → X.Etale), (∀ i : Fin n, IsAffine (U i).left) ∧ (∀ j : Fin m, IsAffine (V j).left) ∧ ∃ (f : (∐ fun j : Fin m => P (V j)) ⟶ (∐ fun i : Fin n => P (U i))) (g : (∐ fun i : Fin n => P (U i)) ⟶ F) (w : f ≫ g = 0), Nonempty (IsColimit (CokernelCofork.ofπ g w))
